title: Roman denial — tradition and unwritten word still needed beside Scripture
source_text: VIII. Sed negant omnes ea quae ad doctrinam fidei & morum in Ecclesia necessaria sunt in Scripturis ita contineri omnia, ut sufficienter inde peti & hauriri possint, sine ope traditionis, & verbi cujusdam non scripti, quod in Ecclesiae corde depositum est.
pass_a_gloss: But they all deny that all those things which are necessary in the Church for the doctrine of faith and morals are so contained in the Scriptures that they can be sufficiently sought and drawn from there without the help of tradition and of a certain unwritten word which is deposited in the heart of the Church.
pass_b_english: Yet they all deny that everything the Church needs for the doctrine of faith and morals is so contained in Scripture that it can be sufficiently sought and drawn from there alone.
They still require the help of tradition and of an unwritten word deposited in the Church's heart.

lemmas.gloss: deposited in the heart of the Church

choices.why: OCR carde to corde; deposit of unwritten word in the Church.
Marks the exact Roman denial against sola Scriptura sufficiency.
